_comment: Format documentation for scripts/seed_concepts.py. This is an EXAMPLE, not
the seed list. SPEC.md section 16 lists the real one as an open question:
'Seed concept list: which ~50 concepts, chosen with input from the Wikidata
WikiProject LGBT community, not unilaterally.' The list therefore does not
live in this repo -- write it into your own file after that conversation and
pass its path to the loader.
Every concept is created local (lifecycle 'local'), never linked to Wikidata.
Linking a concept or term upstream stays with the M7 promotion path in the
web UI, which verifies live that the target already exists -- seeding must
not become a second, weaker way in.
register must be one of: neutral, clinical, outdated, slur, reclaimed,
regional, unknown. language_code must be a seeded content language.
Evidence is not seeded: SPEC.md section 8 computes evidence_grade from
citations that people add, so a seeded term starts at 'single_report' like
any other new term and earns its grade the same way.
